title: process_history should query archived instances
description: process_history only searches active/. When a process reaches a terminal state it gets moved to completed/ or abandoned/, and history queries fail with InstanceNotFoundError. Should fall back to searching completed/ and abandoned/ directories.
close_reason: Fixed in bcd47a9. load_any() searches all directories, history() uses it.

title: process_graph: Mermaid diagram generation
description: MCP tool + CLI command to generate a Mermaid state diagram from a process definition. Shows states, transitions, state types (initial/terminal), and which states have validation gates.

title: process_dry_run: simulate execution without persistence
description: MCP tool + CLI command to walk through a process definition showing what validations would run at each gate, what transitions are available, and optionally simulate a specific path. No state changes, no shell commands executed.

title: process_diff: compare process definition versions
description: MCP tool to diff two versions of a process definition. Show added/removed/modified states, transition changes. Useful when updating shared processes or reviewing PRs that change definitions.

title: process_migrate: in-flight instance migration
description: When a process definition changes while instances are active, detect the version mismatch via definition_hash and offer migration. Check if current state exists in new version with compatible transitions. Suggest options: auto-migrate, abandon+restart, or pin to old version.
close_reason: check_migration() in admin.py, engine.migrate(), MCP process_migrate tool, 7 tests
